jobs.title: Mid-Market Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
About Payoneer
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
Mid-Market Sales Specialist
Role summary:
We’re looking for a highly motivated Mid-Market Sales Specialist within the GTM organization, supporting customers across the EMEA region. 
The ideal candidate is energetic, eager to learn, and ready to grow in a fast-paced environment. 
You will support our customers’ onboarding journey and growth, while helping identify revenue opportunities and deliver an excellent customer experience.
Israel
Hybrid
Full-time
What You’ll Do:
- Support onboarding for new SMB customers across domestic and global markets through telesales outreach, timely follow-ups, and low-touch engagement that helps drive activation and compliance completion.
1. Use CRM tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Aircall, and Marketo to support customer onboarding, assist with KYC completion, and engage prospects through structured call, email, and messaging outreach such as WhatsApp or Telegram.
2. Apply effective communication, active listening, and problem-solving skills to guide customers through the onboarding process and help improve conversion outcomes.
3. Manage communication with new accounts through calls, emails, and automated sequences while working closely with operations teams to support activation and approvals.
4. Help address onboarding, operational, and payment-related issues in a timely manner to support a smooth customer experience and encourage first funded transactions.
- Support onboarding and activation goals for the assigned portfolio by maintaining consistent outreach, encouraging progress to first funded transaction, and introducing customers to relevant Payoneer products where appropriate.
- Proactively share feedback, insights and ideas in team meetings to contribute towards new business growth
Who you are:
- Bachelor’s degree.
- 2-3 years of experience in B2B sales, telesales, inside sales, customer onboarding, customer service, or a related field; internships or early sales experience are an advantage.
- Strong sales acumen with the ability to work in an aggressive, target-driven environment, manage high activity volumes, prioritize effectively, and consistently deliver against deadlines and conversion goals.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
- Fluency in English and Hebrew is a must, with excellent spoken communication, strong call handling ability, and the confidence to engage customers persuasively over the phone.
- Candidates with prior BPO, call center, telesales, or inside sales experience will be strongly preferred, especially those who have managed aggressive follow-up cadences and volume-based onboarding or activation targets.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong persuasive ability, organized reporting, and effective coordination across sales and operations stakeholders.
- Strong desire to learn industry best practices, contribute to the organization, and continuously improve onboarding, activation, and FFT performance outcomes.

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside 
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 
Do it. Own it. 
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 
Continuously improve 
Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 
Build each other up 
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

- Support employer branding initiatives and contribute to continuous improvement of recruitment processes.
Qualifications
- 2+ years of experience in end-to-end in-house recruitment
- Proven track record hiring across multiple functions: Tech, Go-to-Market, and Executive roles
- Global recruiting experience - managing hiring processes across different locations
- Strong analytical mindset - comfortable using data to guide strategy and decisions
- Exceptional relationship-building skills with both hiring managers and candidates
- Proactive, organized, and able to manage multiple hiring processes simultaneously in a dynamic environment
- Native or fluent Hebrew and English, with excellent communication skills (written and verbal)

jobs.title: Data Analyst- Product Data & AI Quality
jobs.description:
Data Analyst – Product Data & AI Quality
At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online. 
Our unique data and solutions empower thousands of customers globally, including industry giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies.
In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange, and we continue to reach new heights! Come work alongside Similarwebbers across the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and good people.
We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our R&D department!
Why is this role so important at Similarweb?
Our Retail Intelligence products help leading brands and retailers understand how their products, brands and categories perform online. Behind them is data collected from retailers and marketplaces around the world, each describing products in its own way. We use LLMs and ML models to classify, normalize and structure that data into a single, trusted view.
As a Data Analyst on the team, you’ll be the person who knows this data best. You’ll own its quality: defining what “correct” looks like, building the ground truth our models are measured against, and finding where things break and why. You’ll work closely with the engineers and scientists who build our LLM and ML pipelines, and with Product, turning what you find into clear priorities. Your work will also directly support our customers: partnering with our customer-facing teams on deep-dive analyses, and investigating and fixing the data gaps that matter most to clients.
It’s a role for someone curious and hands-on, who enjoys digging into data, uses AI tools to move faster, and wants to see their analysis directly shape the product.
So, what will you be doing all day?
Your daily responsibilities may include:
- Analyzing product, brand and category data to find gaps, errors and opportunities to improve coverage and accuracy
- Defining quality metrics and building the dashboards and checks that track them over time
- Building and maintaining ground-truth datasets and labeling guidelines, and running labeling processes
- Evaluating the output of LLM and ML models: error analysis, comparing approaches, and turning findings into concrete improvements
- Using LLMs and AI tools to speed up analysis, labeling and data review
- Helping define and maintain taxonomies and classification rules together with Product
- Supporting client-related needs with our customer-facing teams, from in-depth analyses of specific market segments to investigating and fixing data gaps raised by clients
- Validating new data sources before they are added to the product
- Partnering with Product and engineering to translate findings into requirements and priorities
This is the perfect job for someone who:
- Holds a B.Sc. in Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or another quantitative field
- Has 2+ years of experience as a data analyst, preferably in a tech company
- Has strong SQL skills
- Uses Python for data analysis (pandas, notebooks) - Must
- Has a solid understanding of statistics and evaluation metrics: sampling, precision/recall, confidence levels
- Has hands-on experience using LLMs for data work, such as prompting, structured outputs or reviewing model outputs
- Has strong attention to detail and a structured approach to messy, ambiguous data
- Communicates clearly in English and can present findings to Product, engineering and customer-facing teams
- Has experience with labeling, taxonomies or data quality processes (advantage)
- Has experience with e-commerce or product data (advantage)
- Has experience with BI and visualization tools (advantage)

jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
So, what’s the role all about?
NiCE is seeking an HR Operations specialist to join our Global HR Operations team in Israel. 
This role will play a key role in driving process excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement across Global HR Operations. The successful candidate will partner closely with HR Operations, HRIS, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, and Shared Services teams to identify process improvement opportunities, optimize workflows, strengthen operational governance, improve data quality, and leverage technology to enhance the employee experience and scale HR service delivery globally. 
In addition, this individual will support day-to-day employee lifecycle operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of onboarding, employee changes, mobility, compensation updates, offboarding, and other core HR processes. 
The ideal candidate combines strong HR Operations expertise with a solution-oriented mindset, utilizing data, technology, AI and operational insights to simplify processes, eliminate inefficiencies, and drive sustainable improvements across the HR organization. 
How will you make an impact? 
Process Improvement & Operational Excellence 
- Analyze HR processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, service gaps, and recurring issues. 
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across employee lifecycle processes. 
- Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, governance controls, and operational playbooks. 
- Conduct root-cause analysis and recommend sustainable solutions to improve operational performance. 
Global Employee Lifecycle Management 
- Manage employee lifecycle transactions including onboarding, job changes, mobility, compensation changes, and offboarding. 
- Ensure timely and accurate processing of employee data and HR transactions. 
- Maintain employee records and documentation in compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. 
HR Systems & Service Delivery 
- Partner with HRIS, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and IT teams to optimize HR workflows and system processes. 
- Support enhancements within Oracle HCM, ServiceNow, and related HR technologies. 
- Monitor service delivery metrics and identify opportunities to improve SLA performance and employee experience. 
- Promote adoption of standardized processes and case management best practices. 
Data Governance & Analytics 
- Maintain high standards of HR data quality and integrity. 
- Perform audits and data validation activities to identify and resolve discrepancies. 
- Leverage reporting tools and operational metrics to generate insights and recommendations for HR leadership. 
Have you got what it takes? 
- 2-4 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HRIS, or related HR functions within a global enterprise organization. 
- Demonstrated experience driving process improvements and operational efficiencies. 
- Strong understanding of employee lifecycle processes, HR operations, and service delivery models. 
- Experience working with enterprise HR systems such as Oracle HCM, Workday, or SAP SuccessFactors. 
- Experience working with case management or ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow. 
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills. 
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 
- Fluent English, written and verbal. 
Preferred Qualifications 
- Experience working in a complex global environment. 
- Experience with process mapping, workflow design, and continuous improvement methodologies. 
- Strong reporting and analytics capabilities using Power BI, Excel, or similar tools. 
- Experience supporting automation, system enhancements, or digital transformation initiatives. 
- Familiarity with HR operational governance, quality assurance, and service delivery metrics. 
What’s in it for you?
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

jobs.title: Web Operations Manager - Contractor Position
jobs.description:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. 
As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents.

Cato Networks is looking for a Web Operations Manager as a contractor to keep our web projects organized, our resources focused, and our website up to date. In this contract role, you’ll manage incoming web requests, coordinate work across internal teams and external partners, and perform website updates yourself. 
This role combines strong project management with hands-on execution. You’ll turn requests into clear assignments, balance priorities and capacity, and ensure work moves from intake to launch with consistent quality. 
What you’ll do 
- Manage web ticket requests. Own the request queue, clarify requirements, assess urgency, and establish priorities, owners, and delivery timelines.

jobs.title: Decision Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role:
As a Decision Analyst at Forter, you will own one of the company’s most critical assets: the accuracy, robustness, and performance of what is widely recognized as the leading e-commerce fraud decisioning system in the industry.
You will be expected to think creatively and push boundaries, constantly improving how we identify fraud and protect legitimate customers. You will design logical and technical solutions to real, constantly evolving challenges faced by some of the world’s largest online retailers. Your work will operate at the intersection of deep data research, real-time production decisioning systems, and real-world impact.
This position has strong technical and analytical depth, but you don’t need prior coding experience. With agentic tools like Claude Code and our structured training, candidates that are a strong fit can close any technical gaps quickly. We hire across multiple levels and adjust the scope and level of ownership based on what we learn during the interview process.
You will join Forter’s Decision Science and Analytics department, a high-bar, fast-moving group with a strong culture of excellence, curiosity, and ownership. We work in an informal, collaborative environment where strong opinions are welcome and great ideas move fast. The role offers meaningful growth opportunities, with clear paths toward both senior individual contributor and managerial roles, allowing you to shape your career based on your strengths.
Your work will directly shape Forter’s product, protect hundreds of millions of consumers, and help define the future of trust in digital commerce.
What you'll be doing:
- Invent, design, implement, and continuously refine the core decisioning logic and models that run in Forter’s live production systems
- Research complex fraud patterns, adversarial behaviors, and emerging threats
- Leverage rich and diverse datasets to generate actionable insights, build new system components, and advance feature engineering efforts
- Use agentic tools such as Claude Code to develop automatic tools and processes that improve the accuracy, scalability, and efficiency of our systems
- Collaborate closely with Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to build the next generation of Forter’s AI-driven technology
What you'll need:
- Psychometric score above 700 or equivalent (e.g. GMAT) - we use this as a baseline measure of structured reasoning and analytical speed
- A record of high achievement, in whatever form that's taken in your life - academic, professional, military, or otherwise
- Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills, with a proven ability to break down and solve highly complex problems
- Strong technical orientation. Experience with Python, SQL, or R is an advantage but not required. You should be comfortable learning new tools and technologies
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical ideas and research outcomes to a wide range of audiences
- Natural curiosity and the ability to understand systemic behaviors and adversarial tactics
- Proactive and results-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently within a collaborative team
- Experience building things with AI: agentic workflows, apps, automations. Bring an example you built and can walk us through. You should be enthusiastic about and comfortable with agentic tools.
Bonus points for:
- Experience with SQL or Python
- Familiarity with machine learning concepts
- Background in risk analysis, intelligence, or adversarial research
About us:
Commerce is evolving faster than the systems built to support it. Agentic AI is redrawing how people buy. Customer expectations have a new ceiling. And bad actors are evolving alongside every advancement. 
Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it.
We are a human-first, AI-built company. Our technology analyzes patterns across a network of over 2 billion shoppers, delivering identity intelligence across the entire commerce journey — from sign-up to checkout to returns — that protects revenue and unlocks great customer experiences simultaneously. With Forter, businesses know who to trust, whether it’s humans or the agents shopping for them. The result: zero friction for the customers who matter. No revenue left behind.
The world's most trusted brands — Nordstrom, Instacart, Priceline, Adobe, ASOS, and eBay among them — rely on Forter to get this right. Since 2013, we've raised $525M from investors including Tiger Global, Bessemer, Sequoia Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and today we power commerce decisions for nearly 1 million businesses globally. We're more than fraud, payments and orchestration – we make trust a competitive advantage.
Trust is backed by data – Forter is a recipient of over 10 workplace and innovation awards, including: 
- Great Place to Work Certification (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)
- Fortune’s Best Workplaces in NYC (2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
- Forbes Cloud 100 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025)
- Anti-Fraud Solution of the Year at the Payments Awards (2024)
Life as a Forterian:
Forterians are, genuinely, some of the best people you'll work with. Smart, curious, and deeply good humans who care about the work and each other. That's not an accident — it's something we've been intentional about since day one, and it's the thing people mention most when they talk about why they stay. When you're surrounded by people like this, doing work that actually matters, it changes what a job can feel like.
Forter was built on a simple but powerful conviction: when AI does its job, humans can do theirs better. That philosophy shapes our products and shapes how we work. AI is core to our workflows — not as a shortcut, but as a force multiplier that gives Forterians the space to focus their energy where human judgment is irreplaceable.
We're a global team of 500+ people, with regional headquarters in New York, Tel Aviv, London, and Singapore, and employee presence across the US, Canada, Germany, France, Japan, China, and Australia. Our teams are cross-functional by design, and the work you do here is visible, consequential, and connected to the outcomes that matter.
You'll have real ownership here and proximity to decisions. And we back that with investment in your growth — RSU offerings, L&D programs built around AI tools, and a culture of recognition rooted in our 4.5 day weeks (aka Forter’s Appreciation Fridays and Sundays). From team outings to local cultural celebrations, we mark the moments that matter — wherever you are in the world. We don't want Forter to be just another job. We want it to be the place you build.
If you're ready to work on a problem that sits at the intersection of AI, commerce, and human trust, this is it.
Forter is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that will consider all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, national origin, genetics, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at interviewaccommodation@forter.com. This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.
Hybrid work:
At Forter, we embrace a hybrid work model that blends in-person connection with the flexibility of remote work. Team members based near our key hubs are expected to work from the office at least three days per week. We believe that regular face-to-face collaboration fuels professional development, strengthens our culture, and builds the relationships that help teams thrive.

jobs.title: NetSuite Administrator
jobs.description:
Description
This is us 
Kaltura (NYSE: KLTR) is a global software company on a mission to transform digital experiences from one-way interactions into intelligent, personalized conversations that move people forward.
Founded in 2006, we started by making video more accessible to organizations around the world. Today, we're taking that foundation much further, combining conversational AI, rich media, enterprise knowledge, and data to build a new generation of intelligent digital experiences.
Our technology helps organizations turn their content and knowledge into interactive, AI-powered experiences that can guide customers, train employees, support learners, and engage audiences in real time. From AI agents and personalized learning experiences to digital events, content hubs, and media platforms, we're changing how people interact with technology, and what technology can do for them.
More than 1,000 organizations worldwide rely on Kaltura, reaching over 100 million users at home, at work, and at school.
And the people behind it? We're a global team of 600+ employees, with offices in New York, London, Singapore, and Tel Aviv, united by a culture of openness, flexibility, and collaboration. Kaltura is a fast-paced environment where ideas are welcome, initiative is encouraged, and there's always something new to build, challenge, or improve. We believe in giving people the freedom to make an impact, the flexibility to balance work and life, and the opportunity to grow as we continue to evolve.
If you don't meet 100% of the requirements below, that's okay. Nobody's perfect! We believe in hiring people, not just a list of skills. If this sounds like a place where you'd be excited to learn, contribute, and make an impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Requirements
The role 
We are seeking an experienced NetSuite Administrator to join our Finance Systems team. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and scaling our NetSuite ERP environment while partnering closely with Corporate Accounting and cross-functional stakeholders. You will play a key role in NetSuite implementation and expansion initiatives, finance process automation, systems integration, and continuous improvement efforts across our Finance technology ecosystem.
This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on professional who combines strong NetSuite expertise with a solid understanding of accounting and finance processes, helping drive operational efficiency, scalability, and business growth.
The day-to-day
- Administer, maintain, and optimize the NetSuite platform, ensuring system stability, performance, security, and scalability.
- Partner with Corporate Accounting, Finance, and business stakeholders to improve processes, strengthen controls, and maximize system utilization.
- Configure and maintain NetSuite workflows, saved searches, reports, dashboards, roles, and permissions to support evolving business needs.
- Support NetSuite implementation and enhancement initiatives, including data migration, data conversion, testing, deployment, and post-go-live optimization.
- Support and maintain integrations across the Finance technology ecosystem, with a particular focus on Salesforce (SFDC) and other critical business applications.
- Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives to streamline month-end close, financial reporting, and operational finance processes.
- Troubleshoot system issues, support end users, maintain documentation, and collaborate with global teams across multiple regions and time zones.
﻿Ideally, we’re looking for:
- Hands-on experience administering NetSuite, including configuration, workflows, saved searches, reporting, dashboards, roles, and permissions.
- Strong understanding of Accounting and Finance processes, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, and Month-End Close.
- Experience supporting ERP implementations, system enhancements, integrations, and data migration or conversion initiatives.
- Experience supporting Salesforce (SFDC) integrations and related quote-to-cash or finance business processes.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across global cross-functional teams.
These would also be nice: 
- CPA certification and/or a degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.
- Experience working in a SOX-compliant environment and supporting publicly traded or SaaS companies.
- Experience with SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, AI-enabled tools, FP&A platforms, budgeting, forecasting, planning, or other Finance technology applications.
The perks:
- Hybrid, flexible work environment 
- Extended private health (including mental) insurance 
- Personal and professional development programs 
- Occasional Cross company long weekends

jobs.title: Finance Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
Description
Deloitte is looking for a Manager with hands-on experience in the finance function of a global high-tech company—particularly in software, SaaS, cybersecurity, or digital platforms—to join our Finance Transformation practice and lead the development and delivery of our services to technology companies.
In this role, you will work with senior finance leaders, including CFOs, to redesign finance processes and embed AI as part of broader programs transforming how finance functions operate, while being part of Deloitte’s global Finance Transformation practice.
What you'll do
- Help shape and grow Deloitte’s Finance Transformation offering for the technology sector, bringing your industry experience to a broad range of clients.
- Work with CFOs, controllers, and other senior finance leaders to rethink how their finance functions operate.
- Lead transformation projects spanning finance operating models, processes, reporting, controls, and technology.
- Turn opportunities in AI, automation, and data into practical solutions that improve how finance teams work.
- Guide the finance aspects of ERP and financial system implementations, from business requirements to process design.
- Collaborate with Deloitte’s global network of finance and technology specialists.
- Build client relationships, develop new business opportunities, and lead project teams from planning through delivery.

Must have:
- CPA qualification.
- Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or in a comparable finance role within a global high-tech company, particularly in software, SaaS, cybersecurity, or digital platforms.

Requirements

jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Security
jobs.description:
Description
About Cyera
Come join the company building the security operating model for the age of AI.
AI has changed how data is used - and security must change with it. Cyera's mission is to empower businesses to accelerate AI Adoption by defining a holistic approach to securing AI - from data to access to model. Instead of perimeter controls and static policies, Cyera provides a unified control plane that understands relationships between data, access, and behaviors across humans, systems, and AI. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data and AI security.
About the Role
Earlier this year, Cyera established an entirely new group with a singular focus: Enabling our customers to safely adopt AI. Not just secure AI use after the fact - but discover it, govern it, and protect it end to end.
You'll join this group as we define what enterprise-grade AI security looks like from scratch. The work spans detection and classification of AI usage across the enterprise, governance frameworks for AI agents and models, and the controls that let security teams move as fast as the technology they're protecting against. The market is moving fast - new models, new attack surfaces, new regulatory pressures, new customer needs - and keeping up isn't optional. You'll need to live at the edge of what's happening, synthesize signal from noise, and turn it into product decisions before others have even framed the question.
This is a rare role: Deeply strategic, deeply technical, and deeply consequential.
﻿What You’ll Do
- You'll own product initiatives across the AI security lifecycle - from how enterprises discover AI sprawl across their environments, to how they govern AI agent behavior, to how they enforce data protection in a world where models are the new attack surface. 
- You'll work across the full spectrum - partnering with world-class R&D teams pushing the boundaries of what's technically possible, engaging CISOs and security architects at Fortune 500 companies globally to understand real-world constraints, and collaborating with GTM to translate customer needs into product direction. The environment is fast, sometimes chaotic, and genuinely exciting - the kind of place where the problem space shifts under your feet and that's a feature, not a bug.
Requirements
Who You Are
Must-Haves
- You have a strong track record in B2B product management - ideally in security, data, or enterprise SaaS - but specific knowledge of any of these domains is less critical than authentic curiosity and a proven track record of building great products in a dynamic environment.
- Exceptional product taste and passion for creating delightful product experiences.
- You understand how large organizations actually operate: The compliance pressures, the procurement cycles, the gap between what security teams want and what they can deploy.
- You have a clear point of view on AI and where enterprise security is headed.
- You're as comfortable in a whiteboard session with an enterprise architect as you are deep in a research paper because something just dropped that changes everything.
- You thrive on ambiguity, move with urgency, and find energy in the pace rather than fighting it.
- You are excited about the opportunity to join a team of high performers in a high pressure environment and take an active role in contributing to the success of Cyera and our customers.
﻿Why Join Us?
At Cyera, we own what we build and how we work. Cyerans are empowered to take initiative, move quickly, and turn ideas into impact.
We push boundaries by challenging the status quo, learning fast, and continuously raising the bar - for ourselves and for the industry.
We elevate together by lifting each other up, celebrating wins as a team, and recognizing that our success is shared.
Feel free to apply even if your experience doesn’t tick every box.
We’re building something special here—and we welcome Cyerans with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

jobs.title: Product Economy Manager
jobs.description:
Moon Active is one of the world’s fastest-growing mobile game companies, providing entertainment to millions of active users across the universe. The company is headquartered in the heart of Tel Aviv.
We’re looking for a curious, ambitious and self-motivated Product Economy Manager to join our growing Product team. As a Product Economy Manager, you’ll directly impact millions of our players by creating tools that enable you to balance and optimize the game's economy, resulting in fun and engaging experiences that increase retention and revenue.
Responsibilities 
- 
Design and own the user experience from an economy point of view to predict our players’ behavior according to the data we already have. 
- 
Build simulations and predictive models in order to proactively forecast results of content changes.
- 
Monitor individual and macro player balances to ensure the overall health of the game’s economy.
- 
Explore and design gameplay loops and the way players interact with them. 
- 
Tune content performance by devising A/B tests and analyzing their effectiveness. 
- 
Identify areas where sinks/sources should be tightened or loosened to maximize engagement, retention and revenue. 
- 
Price the game’s virtual currencies. 
- 
Collaborate with Product teams on balancing and designing new features that address existing deficiencies in the game.
Requirements 
- 
Previous experience in Data Analysis.
- 
Bachelor’s Degree in Economics (or Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or similar quantitative field). 
- 
Advanced analytical skills, ability to spot patterns and trends.
- 
Excellent Excel skills.
- 
An interest in mobile games.
- 
Previous experience in strategic/financial consulting - Advantage

jobs.title: Clinical AI Specialist
jobs.description:
About Viz.ai
Viz.ai is the leader in building and deploying AI-powered Care Pathways and helping doctors do their work. The Viz Platform is deployed in 2,000 hospitals across the United States and trusted by many of the leading life sciences companies. The platform uniquely combines real-time, multimodal clinical data with deep clinician engagement to detect disease earlier, coordinate care teams, and help ensure patients receive the right treatment faster. Viz.ai was the first company to be awarded CMS reimbursement for AI and is ranked the #1 Healthcare AI Platform by hospitals and health systems in the Black Book Research survey. For more information, visit Viz.ai.
We are growing and are looking for a Clinical AI Specialist to join our TLV office. 
This is a unique opportunity to see your clinical expertise directly impact a life-saving product. At Viz.ai, you’ll bridge medicine and technology, helping ensure our AI solutions are accurate, clinically meaningful, and scalable. Working closely with engineers, data scientists, and clinicians, you’ll bring the clinical perspective that shapes how we innovate and deliver care at scale.
The Role:
As part of the Clinical AI team, you will:
- 
Help develop AI-based solutions by performing annotations on text data, medical images and signals
- 
Review annotation results, calculate performance metrics, and summarize the findings in clear, comprehensive reports.
- 
Manage clinical tasks within the scrum framework: ensure tasks are clearly defined, documented, and distributed to part-time team members, while also working hands-on execution to advance project deliverables.
- 
Communicate effectively with stakeholders, providing clear status updates and risk assessments.
- 
Track progress and follow up on open assignments to meet deadlines.
- 
Write and maintain detailed guidelines for annotation and clinical tasks.
- 
Act as the clinical point of contact, bridging technical and medical perspectives.
- 
Collaborate with engineers, data managers, and clinicians to drive product development and deliver impactful solutions.
- 
Educate the greater Viz team on medical and clinical topics
 This opportunity may be for you if you're excited about:
- 
Improving clinical workflow
- 
Improving healthcare
- 
Learning new things
- 
Driving innovation in AI
Requirements:
- 
B.A. / M.A. in Brain Sciences, Health/Medical studies
- 
At least 1-2 years of experience with medical imaging/ annotation/ working with medical data a records
- 
Demonstrable in-depth understanding of human anatomy
- 
Medical research oriented
- 
Attention to details
- 
Ability to prioritize effectively
- 
Curious, proactive, and continuous learner with strong interpersonal and collaborative skills.
- 
Strong technical skills, fast learner
- 
People person, team player
You will love this job if you're excited about:
- 
Innovation in the medical domain
- 
Making an impact by working at a company serving more than 1800 hospitals
- 
Training, teaching and knowledge sharing
- 
Working in a startup environment
Location:
We are located in San Francisco, Tel Aviv. This position is based in Tel Aviv.
Our office in Tel-Aviv is located in Menachem Begin 150, within walking distance of Arlozorov and Ha'Shalom train stations.
Why should you join us? 
- 
If you are looking to make an impact, we are mission-driven and are making a difference in peoples’ lives every day.
- 
If you want to be a part of an amazing team , our people are the heart of everything we do.
- 
If you are a self-starter and naturally motivated, our work is driven by curiosity, innovation and team collaboration which allows us to leverage our skills immeasurably.
We are a remote-first company across the U.S. and EU, with a team in Tel Aviv operating in a flexible hybrid model, conveniently located near a train line.
Viz.ai is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided.
In the U.S., Viz offers competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), generous vacation, and additional benefits to full-time employees. Viz.ai is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis prohibited by federal, state, or local law.
Employees in Israel are offered a comprehensive benefits package, including, among others: dental insurance, performance-based bonuses, a Cibus meal allowance, meals at the office, and more.
If you’re applying for a position in San Francisco, please review the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance guidelines applicable in your area.

חברה חדשנית ומובילה בתל אביב מתרחבת ומחפשת מהנדס/ת תעשייה וניהול ג'וניור שרוצה להיכנס לתפקיד דינמי, ללמוד מהטובים ביותר ולהיות חלק מצוות הנדסה מנצח!
מה תעשו ביום-יום?
- תנתחו דאטה ותנהלו בקרה על פרויקטים הנדסיים מרתקים.
- תפיקו דוחות בקרה ותביאו אימפקט אמיתי לפרויקט.
- תעבדו עם הכלים הכי חדשניים בשוק בסביבה טכנולוגית מתקדמת.
- תלמדו, תתפתחו ותפתרו אתגרים הנדסיים מורכבים.
מה אנחנו מציעים?
- ליווי, חניכה והכשרה צמודה ממהנדסים מנוסים שיזניקו אתכם קדימה.
- מסלול קידום אמיתי לטווח הארוך.
- לוקיישן מושלם: משרדים שווים במגדלי מידטאון תל אביב (2 דקות הליכה מרכבת השלום).
- תנאים: משרה מלאה (א'-ה') מהמשרדים.
**המשרה מתאימה למי שקיבל את מסמך הזכאות או הדיפלומה**
דרישות:
 - תואר ראשון בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול (מסמך זכאות רשמי או דיפלומה - חובה).
- 1-2 שנות ניסיון מעשי - רצוי לא חייב.
- שליטה מעולה יישומי Office.
- ראש אנליטי, חשיבה ביקורתית וירידה לפרטים.
- יחסי אנוש מעולים, אנרגיה טובה ויכולת עבודה בצוות.
* המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: מהנדס/ת תעשייה וניהול – תפ״י ומצוינות תפעולית
jobs.description:
1 שנות ניסיון
תיאור משרה
מרכז הליקוט האוטומטי AutoStore | טיב טעם – ראשון לציון
מטרת התפקיד
אחריות על תכנון, בקרה ואופטימיזציה של תהליכי העבודה במרכז הליקוט האוטומטי, תוך שיפור הפריון, ניצולת המערכות, זמינות המלאי ורמת השירות.
תחומי אחריות
• תכנון ופיקוח ייצור (תפ״י): תכנון תוכניות עבודה, קיבולת, עומסים והקצאת כוח אדם בהתאם לתחזיות הזמנות וחלונות אספקה.
• ניתוח ובקרת ביצועים: ניתוח תפוקות, פריון עובדים, ניצולת המערכת, צווארי בקבוק ועמידה ביעדים.
• אופטימיזציה ושיפור תהליכים: חקר עבודה, מדידות זמנים, שיפור שיטות עבודה וצמצום עלויות תפעול.
• עיתוד וניהול מלאי: חיזוי ביקושים, תכנון רמות מלאי, הגדרת מלאי ביטחון, ניתוח חוסרים ומלאי איטי, ושיפור זמינות הפריטים במערכת האוטומטית.
• אופטימיזציה של המערכת, שיפור ניצולת עמדות הליקוט, איזון עומסים, תהליכי הכנסת מלאי וממשקי המערכות.
• בקרה ניהולית: פיתוח דוחות ודשבורדים, הגדרת מדדי KPI והובלת תוכניות התייעלות מבוססות נתונים.
דרישות התפקיד
• תואר ראשון בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול.
• מתאים גם לבוגרים בתחילת דרכם, בעלי ניסיון של 0–3 שנים.
• שליטה גבוהה ב-Excel ויכולת ניתוח נתונים.
• יתרון לניסיון ב-Power BI, SQL ומערכות WMS.
• חשיבה אנליטית, יוזמה, עצמאות ויכולת הובלת תהליכים.
• נכונות לשילוב עבודה אנליטית עם פעילות בשטח.
יעד התפקיד: מקסום תפוקות המערכת, שיפור הפריון וזמינות המלאי, תוך צמצום העלות התפעולית להזמנה ושיפור רמת השירות.
* משרה זו פונה לנשים וגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: Technical Integration Manager
jobs.description:
Were looking for a Technical Integration Manager to join our team and help connect the dots between our business goals and R&D efforts. This hybrid role is ideal for someone who enjoys working between business and technology, combining project coordination with technical understanding.
Youll be the main connection between our business units and R&D - understanding business needs, translating them into clear requirements, aligning priorities, and helping teams deliver successfully. Youll also support product and project activities to move initiatives forward.
Responsibilities:
Serve as the main point of contact between business stakeholders and R&D
Translate business needs into clear requirements and technical briefs
Work closely with R&D to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, and delivery expectations
Own development initiatives end-to-end spec, tasks, QA, rollout, and monitoring whether you build them yourself using AI tools, automation and no-code, or hand them to R&D developers.
Write technical specs and acceptance criteria, and manage the work in task management tools.
Guide and train the business departments on new features documentation, walkthroughs, and ongoing suport
Coordinate cross-functional meetings, updates, and ongoing communication
Assist in planning and prioritizing roadmaps and project timelines
Track and report on progress, risks, and blockers across multiple initiatives
Solve complex tech problems and support the business departments
Build new dashboards for internal and external users using tools like Google Data Studio, Redash, Tableau and others.
Requirements: 
 B.Sc in Industrial engineering and management/ Information System/ Computer Science or equivalent [a must]
2+ years of experience in project management, or technical support
A can-do attitude, willingness to tackle problems or new tasks and go the extra mile
Ability to work within a team or individually
Experience in a product, project, or technical coordination role
Knowledge/experience in Python and SQL
Understanding of APIs, JSON, webhooks, authentication, and system integrations
Experience working with data and translating business requirements into KPIs, reports, and dashboards
Understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and AI-powered automation
Ability to identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve business and technical processes
Familiarity with working with AI APIs and AI-based tools
Good mathematics, problem-solving, interpersonal and organizational skills
Ability to drive tasks to completion in a cross discipline environment
Detail-oriented with a focus on delivery and follow-through
Fluent in English and Hebrew (spoken and written) [a must]
Familiarity with agile methodologies and tools like Jira and Trello [Advantage]
Previous experience in an adtech, media, or SaaS company [Advantage]
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: FP&A Business Partner, Finance
jobs.description:
Medison is addressing one of the pharma industry’s most pressing challenges: enabling access to breakthrough therapies for patients with severe and rare diseases in international markets where traditional commercialization models fall short. As the creator and leader of the global partnership category, Medison has built a first-of-its-kind unified commercialization platform that enables biotechs to effectively plan, optimize and launch their therapies on a global scale. With a strong leadership team and a proven track record, Medison is the partner of choice for innovative biotech companies seeking to expand beyond the US, Western Europe and Japan into regions where most of the world’s population resides. Medison’s affiliate-like model integrates commercial, medical and operational capabilities across diverse geographies, accelerating access and delivering life-changing treatments to more patients, faster. Medison is on a mission to ensure that every patient, regardless of where they live, has the opportunity to benefit from breakthrough therapies. We are looking for a high-impact FP&A Business Partner to join our Corporate FP&A team. This role primarily focuses on financial planning, analysis, business partnering, and driving AI-enabled FP&A transformation, supporting a fast-growing, dynamic organization. The ideal candidate is a strong finance professional and strategic thinker, capable of turning complex data into actionable insights and supporting decision-making at senior levels, with a strong affinity for data, automation, and embedding AI tools into day-to-day FP&A processes, and a hands-on approach and a willingness to dive into the details and get the work done. 
Responsibilities: 
 Business Partnering & Financial Leadership Act as a trusted financial advisor to business units, partnering closely with senior stakeholders to support decision-making Provide clear financial guidance, insights, and recommendations to leadership Collaborate cross-functionally to align financial plans with business goals and KPIs 
 Planning, Forecasting & Analysis Lead the business partner annual budgeting, quarterly estimates, month closing and other forecasting and planning processes Perform variance analysis (Actual vs. Budget vs. Forecast) and deliver actionable insights Build and maintain financial models supporting corporate performance and strategic initiatives Prepare executive-level reporting, presentations, and KPI dashboards Leverage FP&A systems and data tools and emerging AI capabilities (e.g., Anaplan, NetSuite, Priority, BI) to support analysis, ensure data accuracy, and improve reporting processes, with a solid understanding of underlying data flows and systems logic 
 AI-Driven FP&A Excellence Leverage AI, automation, and advanced analytics tools to enhance forecasting, planning, and business insights Drive the adoption and integration of AI tools (e.g., predictive models, copilots, automation solutions) into core FP&A workflows Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and streamline processes using AI and automation Partner with data, BI, and technology teams to embed scalable AI-driven solutions into financial processes Ability to leverage technology for automation, insight generation, and storytelling 
 Continuous Improvement & Ad-hoc Initiatives Lead and support cross-company initiatives and ad-hoc analysis Proactively identify and implement process improvements, optimize, and automate financial processes Operate effectively in a fast-paced, fast-growing, changing, and agile environment Ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal policies Drive FP&A process transformation initiatives, with a focus on automation, scalability, and AI enablement 
City: 
Petah Tikva
Requirements: 
 Education and Experience: B.A in Economics, Industrial Engineering, Accounting or Business administration 
This position is open to all candidates.

ליווי גורמים מטעם משרד התחבורה ביישום פעילויות חינוכיות להטמעת תרבות שימוש בתחב"צ ברשות המקומית.
ליווי גורמים מטעם התחבורה בביצוע סקרי תחב"צ ברשות המקומית.
ריכוז תוכניות אב לתחבורה ציבורית וריכוז תוניות עירוניות וחיבורם לתחב"צ.
ביצוע כל מטלה נוספת שתידרש עפ"י החלטת הממונה.

jobs.title: אחראי /ת פרויקטי גמר לתואר ראשון ביה"ס להנדסת תעשייה ומערכות נבונות
jobs.description:
ריכוז, ניהול ופיתוח פעילות פרויקטי הגמר בבית הספר, לרבות גיבוש תהליכי עבודה וליווי שוטף של כלל הגורמים המעורבים. ייזום, פיתוח וטיפוח קשרי עבודה ושיתופי פעולה עם גורמי חוץ בתעשייה, בארגוני שירות, במוסדות ציבוריים ובאקדמיה, לצורך איתור וקידום פרויקטים. בחינה, אישור והקצאת פרויקטים לסטודנטים ולמנחים, ומעקב אחר התקדמותם לאורך שלבי הביצוע השונים. קיום קשר שוטף עם מנחי הפרויקטים ועם אנשי הקשר בארגונים השותפים, ומתן מענה מקצועי ותפעולי בהתאם לצורך. ניהול ותפעול אתר הקורס ומעקב אחר פעילות צוותי הפרויקטים בהתאם למתודולוגיות העבודה שנקבעו. תכנון, ארגון וריכוז אירועי הצגת פרויקטי הגמר, לרבות ימי מצגות, תערוכות סוף שנה ואירועים פקולטיים. ייזום ימי מצגות סטודנטים, הרצאות אורח ופעילויות אקדמיות משלימות בתחום הפרויקטים. ייצוג בית הספר מול יחידות הפקולטה והאוניברסיטה וקידום שיתופי פעולה פנים-ארגוניים. ביצוע מטלות נוספות בהתאם להנחיית הממונים.
דרישות:
 תואר שני בהנדסה או במדעים מדויקים. תואר בהנדסת תעשייה וניהול - יתרון. היכרות עם התעשייה ויכולת לפתח ולקיים קשרי עבודה עם ארגונים רלוונטיים בתחומי הנדסת תעשייה ומערכות, בדגש על מערכות ביטחוניות, מערכות בריאות וארגונים מובילים במשק. ניסיון בהוראה, בהדרכה ו/או בליווי פרויקטים אקדמיים או מקצועיים - יתרון. יכולת ייזום, הובלת תהליכים ופיתוח שיתופי פעולה. יכולת עבודה עצמאית והשתלבות בצוות. ידיעת השפה העברית על בוריה וידיעת השפה האנגלית ברמה טובה מאד, לרבות יכולת הבעה ותכתובת בשפות אלה. יכולת למידה עצמית של נושאים מורכבים והתעדכנות מקצועית. יכולת ארגון, תכנון, תיאום ומעקב ברמה גבוהה. יכולת התמודדות עם עומס משימות ועמידה בלוחות זמנים. תודעת שירות גבוהה ויחסי אנוש מעולים. הערה: נדרשת נכונות לעבודה בשעות נוספות עפ"י הצורך. כפיפות: אחראי אקדמי של קורס הפרויקט ולראשת המינהל. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager leads a cross-functional/multidisciplinary team of Leaders and their respective project teams for PET programs in Haifa, to deliver project objectives., The program manager drives clarity by continuously defining and prioritizing work, defines the critical success factors/deliverables for the team.
Job Description
Duties include (but are not limited to):
1. Overall responsibility for program success providing engineering innovation within time, budgetary, quality and performance constraints and guidance to continuously deliver products directly supporting the overall business strategy. 
2. Creates and ensures effective and efficient communication across business functions. 
3. Applies leadership to motivate and energize the variety of cross-functional teams consisting of the program. 
4. Works closely and transparently with Product Leadership and Business Leadership to align program with market dynamics and drive program direction.
5. Leads cross-functional and/or multi-disciplinary program planning, drives the team to generate trade-offs and identify and manage risks from the early planning phase, throughout the entire program execution. 
6. Works as an equal partner with the program team to deliver results, understands and openly supports all functional goals.
7. Solves complex and ambiguous problems, leads the strategic and forward-thinking program execution including (but not limited to) concept discussion, program execution, rollout, training, pilot trials, clinical evaluations until successful deployment to serial production. 
8. Works with customers to solicit input and feedback to meet quality and customer expectations.
9. Provides expert guidance and support to the program organization in various technical/functional aspects.
10. Creates and supports the stewardship of intellectual property with appropriate security of project documentation.
Requirements: 
 1. Bachelors Degree within appropriate Engineering/Science discipline with at least 2 years of cross-functional Project and/ or Technical Leadership experience.
2. Minimum of 5 years of experience in program management or project leadership of multi-disciplinary systems within a development, technical industry, manufacturing and/or research environment.
3. Demonstrated execution at meeting project goals while satisfying quality, performance, schedule, and budget CTQs.
4. Demonstrated engineering knowledge, program management, and business planning processes, having experience with the full product lifecycle from concept through end of life.
5. Familiarity with IEC, FDA EMC, and other regulatory standards.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: סגן /ית  מנהל /ת תוכנית החומש
jobs.description:
חברתנו מחפשת סגן/ית מנהל /ת לתוכנית החומש, לתפקיד המשלב ניהול תוכניות עבודה, תיאום בין שותפים, מעקב אחר ביצוע וקידום יעדים ארגוניים וקהילתיים. התפקיד נועד לסייע למנהל/ת התוכנית בהובלת יישומה לאורך התקופה, תוך תרגום מטרות אסטרטגיות לפעולות מעשיות, הגדרת אבני דרך והבטחת רציפות תפעולית. העבודה תיעשה בשיתוף גורמי מטה ושטח, מנהלי מרכזים קהילתיים, רשויות מקומיות ושותפים רלוונטיים, בהתאם למבנה התוכנית ולתחומי פעילותה. 
 במסגרת התפקיד תהיה אחריות על: - לריכוז תוכניות עבודה שנתיות ורבשנתיות. - תיאום משימות בין הגורמים המעורבים ולמעקב אחר עמידה בלוחות זמנים וביעדים. - סיוע בתכנון ובבקרת תקציב, ריכוז נתוני ביצוע, הכנת דוחות תקופתיים והצגת תמונת מצב ניהולית לצורך קבלת החלטות. - זיהוי חסמים וסיכונים, יגבש הצעות לפתרון ויקדם תהליכי שיפור בהתבסס על נתונים, משוב מהשטח וצרכים משתנים. - הכנה וריכוז של ישיבות עבודה, מעקב אחר החלטות, ליווי גורמים מבצעים והטמעת נהלים וכלי בקרה. - נדרשת יכולת לחבר בין ראייה מערכתית לבין עבודה מעשית ומדויקת, תוך שמירה על סדרי עדיפויות ועל תקשורת רציפה עם שותפים חיצוניים. - במסגרת הסמכויות שיוגדרו, הסגן/ית ייצג את התוכנית בפורומים מקצועיים וימלא את מקום מנהל /ת התוכנית בעת הצורך. - קידום יעדי התוכנית, בשיפור איכות הביצוע, בחיזוק שיתופי הפעולה והנגשת מידע אמין ועדכני להנהלת התוכנית ולשותפים הרלוונטיים.
דרישות:
 תכנון אסטרטגי ותרגום יעדים לתוכניות עבודה ישימות. ניהול פרויקטים ותיאום משימות מרובות במקביל. מעקב ובקרה אחר תקציבים, לוחות זמנים ומדדי ביצוע. ניתוח נתונים והפקת תובנות לצורך קבלת החלטות. הובלת תהליכים ועבודה בממשקים ללא סמכות ישירה. בניית שותפויות וניהול קשרי עבודה עם גורמי מטה ושטח. כתיבת דוחות, מסמכי עבודה ומצגות ניהוליות. זיהוי סיכונים, פתרון בעיות והתמודדות עם חסמים. תקשורת בין-אישית וניהול דיונים מקצועיים. סדר, ארגון, תיעדוף משימות וירידה לפרטים. 
 דרישות התפקיד: תואר ראשון בתחום רלוונטי, כגון ניהול, מדיניות ציבורית, חינוך או מדעי החברה, או ניסיון מקצועי מקביל ורלוונטי- חובה ניסיון בניהול של 10-20 עובדים- חובה ניסיון בניהול או בריכוז תוכניות ופרויקטים הכוללים מספר שותפים. ניסיון בבניית תוכניות עבודה ובמעקב אחר יישומן. ניסיון בריכוז נתונים, בהכנת דוחות ביצוע ובהצגת מידע להנהלה. ניסיון בעבודה עם תקציבים גדולים ובבקרה תקציבית. ניסיון בתיאום בין יחידות ארגוניות ובהנעת גורמים לביצוע משימות. שליטה ביישומי Office, בדגש על Excel וPowerPoint. יכולת ניסוח גבוהה בעברית, בכתב ובעל פה. נכונות לעבודת שטח ולהשתתפות בפגישות באתרי הפעילות, בהתאם לצורכי התפקיד. היכרות עם פעילות מרכזים קהילתיים, רשויות מקומיות או תוכניות ציבוריות וחברתיות - יתרון. 
 היקף המשרה: 100% משרה בחוזה אישי. מיקום המשרה: מטה החברה בלוד. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: technical  Project Manager
jobs.description:
the company is looking for a talented project management officer (pmo) or technical pm with experience with software, infrastructure or cloud (aws, azure) projects in an agile and complicated environment.
as a pmo, you will be a part of the company department and will be responsible of:
collaborating with other department leaders to define, prioritize, and develop projects.
planning project management, including setting deadlines, prioritizing tasks, and assigning team members to various deliverables.
analyzing financial data, including project budgets, risks, and resource allocation.
providing financial reports and budget outlines to executives.
overseeing the development of the project and ensuring that team members are carrying out their tasks efficiently while upholding the company's standards.
drafting new and improving existing project management office policies and processes.
continuously evaluating projects to ensure they are meeting company standards, adhering to budgets, and meeting deadlines.
accurately documenting the project's creation, development, and execution as well as documenting the project's scope, budget, and justification.
Requirements: 
 job requirements:
problem solver and good analytical skills
team player
good interpersonal skills - the ability to work remotely while developing and maintaining relationships.

החברה מפעילה ומנהלת פתרונות דיגיטליים עבור מועדוני צרכנות גדולים וארגונים מובילים במשק, תוך יצירת חוויית משתמש מתקדמת, חדשנית וחלקה בקנה מידה רחב.
כחלק מהמשך הצמיחה והחדשנות שלנו בעולם ההטבות הדיגיטליות, אנחנו מחפשים מנהל /ת מוצר מוכשר/ת שיצטרף/תצטרף לצוות המוצר שלנו וישפיע/תשפיע על פיתוח והובלת המוצרים המרכזיים של החברה.
במסגרת התפקיד תדווח/י ל-Head of Product במחלקת השיווק ותוביל/י את מחזור חיי המוצר מקצה לקצה.
התפקיד כולל אפיון והובלת משפכים דיגיטליים מורכבים, עבודה מרובת ממשקים והבטחת Delivery איכותי בסביבה דינמית ובקנה מידה רחב.
אנחנו מחפשים אדם יוזם, עצמאי ובעל יכולת הובלה, שיודע לחבר בין מטרות עסקיות וחוויית משתמש ולייצר אימפקט אמיתי.

 ניהול מחזור חיי המוצר מקצה לקצה - החל ממחקר שוק ואפיון דרישות, דרך השקה ועד ניטור ביצועים ושיפור מתמיד.
הגדרה ואופטימיזציה של מסעות משתמש ומשפכים דיגיטליים מורכבים, כולל אינטגרציות בין מערכות שונות.
הובלת תהליכים חוצי ארגון ועבודה שוטפת מול צוותי שיווק, עיצוב, מכירות, שירות, תפעול ופיתוח.
שיפור חוויית המשתמש על בסיס ניתוח התנהגות משתמשים והבנה עמוקה של UX / UI במטרה לשפר שביעות רצון והמרות.
הגדרת KPIs ומעקב אחר ביצועי המוצר באמצעות ניתוח נתונים וזיהוי הזדמנויות לצמיחה ואופטימיזציה.
משרה מלאה, משרדי החברה בפתח תקווה (משרה היברידית- יומיים בשבוע מהבית).
דרישות:
 לפחות שנתיים ניסיון בניהול מוצר - חובה.
ניסיון בעבודה בסביבות B2B או B2B2C- חובה.
תואר ראשון בתחומי הנדסה, מנהל עסקים או תחום רלוונטי אחר.
יכולת הובלה עצמאית של פרויקטים רחבי היקף וחוצי ארגון - משלב הרעיון ועד הביצוע.
הבנה חזקה במשפכים דיגיטליים, אופטימיזציית המרות (CRO) ואסטרטגיות שימור משתמשים.
הבנה מעמיקה של UX / UI ותשוקה ליצירת מוצרים אינטואיטיביים וממוקדי משתמש.
חשיבה אנליטית ויכולת לתרגם דאטה וצרכים עסקיים ל-Roadmap מוצרי ברור וישים.
כישורי תקשורת בין-אישיים מצוינים ויכולת להניע ולהשפיע על ממשקים מגוונים בארגון. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
As a Product Manager at Limitless-Labs, you will lead the development of a one-of-a-kind AI Machining Agent, shaping a product at the intersection of AI, algorithms, and advanced manufacturing. You will deeply understand business goals and user needs in a complex, real-world environment, and work closely with AI, algorithms, and software teams to turn cutting-edge technology into a market-ready product.
This is an intensive and challenging role, where youll push the boundaries of whats possible alongside a top-tier, highly talented team. Youll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to deliver a best-in-class product that sets a new standard in the industry.
What Youll Do
Own the product vision and roadmap for our AI Machining Agent, from concept through launch and iteration.
Translate complex business, user, and manufacturing needs into clear product requirements and priorities.
Work hands-on with AI, algorithms, and software teams to define problems, design solutions, and deliver high-impact features.
Drive product discovery through user research, data analysis, and close collaboration with customers and internal stakeholders.
Make fast, high-quality decisions in a dynamic and ambiguous environment, balancing short-term execution with long-term strategy.
Define success metrics, track product performance, and continuously iterate to improve outcomes.
Act as the voice of the product, aligning engineering, leadership, and go-to-market teams around a shared vision.
Requirements: 
 A product manager / system engineer who thrives in complex, technical domains and enjoys turning ambiguity into clarity.
Comfortable working closely with engineers and domain experts. Able to hold meaningful conversations about technical trade-offs.
Driven by impact and ownership, with a strong bias toward execution and delivering real value to users.
Strategic in thinking, yet hands-on in practice - equally comfortable defining long-term vision and sweating the details
Curious, fast-learning, and excited by pushing the limits of what AI and manufacturing technology can do together.
Resilient and adaptable, with the ability to operate in an intensive, fast-paced environment.
A strong communicator who can align diverse stakeholders around a shared product direction.
This position is open to all candidates.

Excellent visualization and presentation skills
Highly independent, proactive, and a fast learner, capable of prioritizing in a dynamic environment and fostering cross-functional collaboration
English at a professional capacity and great communication skills, both in person and written

תנתחו תוצאות ונתונים עסקיים, תסיקו מסקנות ותגבשו המלצות מבוססות נתונים להנהלה.

יכולת שיתוף פעולה ועבודה מול ממשקים רבים (רתימה של ממשקים).

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing Analytics & Growth team and play a key role in tracking, analyzing, and optimizing the companys overall performance across customers. 
The role focuses on defining event tracking, attributes, and properties mapping, analyzing conversion funnels, and identifying trends or issues using web analytics tools. You will work closely with R&D, Professional Services, Product managers, and the Business Intelligence team to ensure data integrity, validate tracking implementations, support new feature launches, and enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. 
The ideal candidate is highly independent, curious, and proactive, with a strong drive to uncover root causes and continuously learn new tools and methods to solve complex analytical challenges. 
Responsibilities: 
Define, implement, and maintain event tracking, attributes, and properties across web and product platforms 
Gather and analyze data from multiple sources, including web analytics, internal systems, session recordings, and online browsing activities 
Conduct in-depth analyses of customers conversion funnels and trends to identify optimization opportunities, as well as raise alerts and potential issues 
Monitor KPIs related to conversion, engagement, and overall company performance 
Guide and support our e-commerce funnel optimization with data backed insights. 
Collaborate with R&D, product managers, and cross-functional teams to define tracking needs, raise alerts, and support new feature launches 
Ensure web analytics data is accurately reflected in BI dashboards and reports, enabling reliable decision-making and insights 
Conduct and analyze AB testing together with the Payments, Product and Professional Services teams, to measure the effect of new features, payment methods and other growth initiatives for our customers, and provide recommendations and conclusions. 
Provide actionable, data-backed insights to support company-wide strategy and analytical projects 
Take initiative to learn independently, adopt new analytical approaches, and work autonomously on complex problems
Requirements: 
 BSc in Industrial Engineering & Management, Economics, Statistics, or related analytical field 
2+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in customer-focused or digital analytics roles 
Strong proficiency in web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics/GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Shopify Analytics, Adobe Analytics) 
Experience with AB testing and Product Analytics 
Proficiency in SQL and large and complex data sets 
High proficiency in Excel 
Experience working with BI tools- preferably QlikSense 
Solid understanding of conversion funnels, event tracking, and data quality validation 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including product, tech, and BI 
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and presentation skills 
Detail-oriented with strong business understanding, analytical depth and ability to manage large, complex datasets 
Independent, proactive, and quick learner with strong self-motivation and ownership mindset 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: Finance Transformation Manager
jobs.description:
KPMG סומך חייקין, ידועה בהיותה מקום נהדר לעבוד בו, להתפתח ולבנות קריירה ארוכת טווח. KPMG מספקת שירותי ביקורת, מס וייעוץ לארגונים בתעשיות החשובות ביותר של היום. הצמיחה שלנו מונעת על ידי מתן תוצאות אמיתיות עבור הלקוחות שלנו. היא באה לידי ביטוי גם בתרבות שלנו, המעודדת פיתוח אישי, סביבת עבודה ייחודית ומתגמלת, המקדמת התפתחות אישית ומקצועית . אנו מחפשים מנהל/ת מנוסה להובלת פרויקטים בתחום ה-Finance Transformation , בעל/ת הבנה מעמיקה של תהליכים פיננסיים ועסקיים, יכולת לזהות הזדמנויות לשיפור והתייעלות, ולתרגם אותן להמלצות פרקטיות ולתוכניות יישום. מועמד/ת עם אוריינטציה עסקית וייעוצית חזקה, שיודע/ת להיכנס לארגון, להבין במהירות כיצד פונקציית הכספים והתהליכים התומכים בה פועלים בפועל, לזהות פערים והזדמנויות ולסייע ללקוח בתכנון ובהובלת השינוי. על התפקיד: הובלת פרויקטים והתקשרויות בתחום Finance Transformation באופן עצמאי. ניתוח והבנה של תהליכים פיננסיים ועסקיים מקצה לקצה ובחינת תהליכים מרכזיים בפונקציית הכספים. ביצוע מיפוי וניתוח של המצב הקיים והגדרת תהליכים עתידיים ,זיהוי פערים והזדמנויות לשיפור. שימוש במתודולוגיות וכלים לשיפור והתייעלות בתהליכים עסקיים בחינת ממשקים בין People, Process & Technology לרבות השפעת מערכות ERP וטכנולוגיות פיננסיות על תהליכי העבודה. סיוע בעיצוב Target Operating Model לפונקציית הכספים וגיבוש Roadmap ליישום השינוי. ניהול שוטף של הלקוח, תיאום ציפיות, ניהול משימות ולוחות זמנים והנעת הגורמים המעורבים בפרויקט. זיהוי צרכים והזדמנויות נוספות אצל לקוחות ותרומה לפיתוח והרחבת פעילות הFinance Transformation-
דרישות:
 ניסיון משמעותי של תהליכים פיננסיים ועסקיים בארגון -חובה היכרות וניסיון עם מתודולוגיות וכלים לשיפור והתייעלות בתהליכים עסקיים -חובה יכולת גבוהה בהתנהלות מול לקוחות, יכולת שירותית וייעוצית גבוהה ובניית מערכת יחסים מקצועית ואפקטיבית עם הלקוח. אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד, בכתב ובעל פה -חובה רו"ח מוסמך/ת (CPA) או בעל/ת רקע חשבונאי ופיננסי -יתרון ניסיון בעבודה בחברות טכנולוגיה ו/או חברות גלובליות -יתרון היכרות עם מערכות ERP כגון SAP, Oracle NetSuite , , כלי BI (Power BI) -יתרון ניסיון בפרויקטים של שיפור תהליכים, אוטומציה והטמעת מערכות -יתרון המשרה מיועדת לגברים, נשים ואנשים עם מוגבלויות כאחד. המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: Paid Acquisition Specialist, search
jobs.description:
What am I going to do?
Monitor and optimize paid search campaigns across multiple channels, primarily Google Search, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance workflows, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen campaign analysis.
Continuously explore and implement AI driven methods to improve campaign performance and team productivity.
Stay up to date on the latest trends in paid search and digital marketing, continuously integrating new tactics to maintain a competitive edge.
Use analytical tools to evaluate campaign performance and deliver actionable insights to stakeholders, helping the team make informed decisions and achieve its goals.
Develop and manage monthly budget plans to optimize ROI.
Act as a point of contact for the external data and analytics team, aligning on measurement strategy, data access, and performance modeling.
Build and maintain dashboards to monitor team KPIs, uncover performance patterns, and track progress toward goals.
Requirements: 
 1+ years of Hands On experience in paid search or Performance Marketing, with experience in data driven campaign execution and optimization.
High level of AI fluency, including the use of automation and AI tools to streamline workflows, optimize campaign execution, and improve analytical processes.
Experience managing campaigns in Google Ads with clear performance ownership.
Proficient in Excel and Google Sheets, with experience organizing and analyzing data to generate actionable insights that support business decisions. Familiarity with SQL is a plus.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar platforms is a plus.
Comfortable conducting both ad hoc and in depth analyses, identifying trends, performance gaps, and making projections to support planning.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present data clearly and deliver actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
Strong problem solving skills, with an innovative mindset and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast paced, dynamic environment.
Independent, self driven, and proactive, able to take ownership and identify opportunities.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross functional teams while demonstrating ownership and accountability within your domain.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Data Science, or a related field.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: אנליסט/ית מלאי ובקרה
jobs.description:
אנליסט/ית המלאי משלב/ת חשיבה עסקית, אנליטית ותפעולית, ואחראי/ת על אופטימיזציה של רמות המלאי, מניעת חוסרים ומקסום רווחיות. התפקיד מהווה גורם מרכזי לתחקור נתוני מכירות ומלאי, ניתוחי אד-הוק, בניית כלי עבודה יישומיים, ומשמש כתובת תפעולית לריכוז ופתרון חוסרים מול המוסכים בשטח.
תחומי אחריות
- תמיכה בקבלת החלטות אסטרטגיות מבוססות דאטה: הפקת דוחות ביצועים, ניתוח ערכי מלאי מול תקציב, והצפת סיכונים ופערים להנהלה ולממשקים.
- איתור פערים בזמינות מוצרים: זיהוי חוסרים מתהווים או פערים בזמינות חלפים במוסכים, ומתן פתרונות מיידיים.
- ניהול וריכוז חוסרים מול המוסכים: כתובת מרכזית בשטח; תכלול בקשות, ניתוח סיבות שורש וקידום פתרונות.
- ניתוח חודשי מלאי, מלאי מת ואיטי: בקרת עלויות החזקת מלאי, איתור פריטים עודפים וגיבוש המלצות לצמצומם.
- ניתוח נתוני מכירות והפקת תובנות אופרטיביות: מעקב אחר מגמות צריכה, קצבי מכירה ועונתיות, ותרגומם להמלצות תפעוליות לרכש ולתכנון.
- בניית כלי עבודה ודוחות בקרה: אפיון ופיתוח כלים, מחשבונים ודוחות באקסל ובמערכות BI לייעול העבודה.
- טיוב דאטה: בקרת איכות הנתונים ועבודה מול ממשקים לעדכון ותחזוקה.
- הטמעת כלי AI לניתוח נתונים: זיהוי הזדמנויות לייעול תהליכים, ניתוח נתונים, אוטומציה, יצירת דוחות ותמיכה בקבלת החלטות.
- ניסיון של שנתיים לפחות בעבודה עם בסיסי נתונים גדולים ומורכבים, ויכולת ניתוח והסקת מסקנות- חובה.
- תואר ראשון בכלכלה / הנדסת תעשייה וניהול / לוגיסטיקה / מערכות מידע וכדומה- חובה.
- ניסיון קודם בתפקיד דומה בעולמות שרשרת אספקה, מלאי, רכש- יתרון משמעותי מאוד
- רקע מענף הרכב (היכרות עם עולם החלפים, המוסכים או יבואני הרכב)- יתרון משמעותי

jobs.title: מנתח /ת מערכות  data
jobs.description:
אם אתם אוהבים להבין את הצורך העסקי, לבנות את הפתרון וללוות אותו עד שהוא באמת עולה לייצור - אנחנו מחפשים אתכם. אנחנו מגייסים מנתח/ת מערכות data. התפקיד מהווה את חוליית הקישור בין הגורמים העסקיים בחברה לבין צוותי הפיתוח והתשתיות, וכולל אחריות מלאה על מחזור החיים של דרישה עסקית: מהבנת הצורך, דרך אפיון הפתרון ומודל הנתונים, ועד לפיתוח בפועל של תהליכי העיבוד והעלייה לייצור. התפקיד אגנוסטי לטכנולוגיה. אנחנו מחפשים אדם שמסוגל להיכנס לכל סביבה, ללמוד אותה לעומק ולייצר בה ערך: סביבות On-Prem לצד ענן, מסדי נתונים רלציוניים לצד NoSQL, תהליכי Batch לצד תהליכי זמן אמת. הדגש הוא על עומק אנליטי, אחריות מקצה לקצה ויכולת לתרגם דרישה עסקית לקוד שרץ בייצור, ולא על שליטה בכלי ספציפי. 
 תחומי אחריות איסוף וניתוח דרישות עסקיות מול גורמים באגפי הביטוח, החיסכון ארוך הטווח, הכספים, השירות והאקטואריה, ותרגומן למסמכי אפיון פונקציונליים וטכניים. אפיון ותכנון מודלי נתונים ומבני DWH לתמיכה בתהליכי הליבה ובצרכי הדיווח, האנליטיקה והרגולציה. כתיבת שאילתות SQL מורכבות, אופטימיזציה של ביצועים וטיפול בצווארי בקבוק בסביבות ייצור עתירות נתונים. אפיון ומימוש ממשקים בין מערכתיים, תהליכי העברת קבצים ומנגנוני סנכרון בזמן אמת. ליווי צמוד של צוותי הפיתוח וה- QA משלב הדרישה ועד המסירה ללקוח העסקי, כולל בדיקות אינטגרציה ובקרת איכות נתונים. ניהול העלייה לייצור, לרבות תיאום מול ממשקים ויחידות עסקיות ובקרה על תקינות התהליכים לאחר העלייה. שמירה על תיעוד, בקרת גרסאות ותהליכי CI/CD בהתאם לסטנדרטים הארגוניים.
דרישות:
 דרישות חובה: 5+ ש"נ בניתוח מערכות מידע ותהליכי דאטה, כולל ניסיון מוכח בכתיבת מסמכי אפיון מלאים. שליטה גבוהה ב-SQL, לרבות כתיבת פרוצדורות ופונקציות, ניתוח תוכניות ביצוע ואופטימיזציה של שאילתות. ניסיון מעשי בפיתוח ובתחזוקה של תהליכי ETL /ELT בסביבות ארגוניות עתירות נתונים. ניסיון בעבודה עם מסד נתונים רלציוני ולא רלציוני הבנה עמוקה של מידול נתונים, לרבות מידול ממדי, Star Schema ונרמול. יכולת עבודה עצמאית מקצה לקצה: מהבנת הדרישה העסקית ועד קוד שרץ בייצור. ניסיון בעבודה מול גורמים עסקיים ויכולת להנגיש תכנים טכניים לדרג לא טכני. היכרות עם מתודולוגיות Agile ו-Scrum 
 כישורים אישיים: חשיבה אנליטית ויכולת פירוק בעיות מורכבות לרכיבים ברי מימוש. אחריות אישית גבוהה ויכולת לקחת בעלות על תהליך מקצה לקצה. יכולת עבודה בסביבה מרובת ממשקים ובעלת קצב שינוי גבוה. תקשורת בין אישית טובה ויכולת עבודה בצוות. סקרנות טכנולוגית ונכונות ללמוד כלים וסביבות חדשות המשרה מיועדת לנשים ולגברים כאחד.

jobs.title: data analyst- product  data & ai quality
jobs.description:
at the company, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online.
our unique data and solutions empower thousands of customers globally, including industry giants like google, ebay, and adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies.
in 2021, we went public on the new york stock exchange, and we continue to reach new heights! come work alongside our teammates across the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and good people.
were looking for a data analyst to join our r&d department!
why is this role so important at the company?
our retail intelligence products help leading brands and retailers understand how their products, brands and categories perform online. behind them is data collected from retailers and marketplaces around the world, each describing products in its own way. we use llms and ml models to classify, normalize and structure that data into a single, trusted view.
as a data analyst on the team, youll be the person who knows this data best. youll own its quality: defining what correct looks like, building the ground truth our models are measured against, and finding where things break and why. youll work closely with the engineers and scientists who build our llm and ml pipelines, and with product, turning what you find into clear priorities. your work will also directly support our customers: partnering with our customer-facing teams on deep-dive analyses, and investigating and fixing the data gaps that matter most to clients.
its a role for someone curious and hands-on, who enjoys digging into data, uses ai tools to move faster, and wants to see their analysis directly shape the product.
so, what will you be doing all day?
your daily responsibilities may include:
 analyzing product, brand and category data to find gaps, errors and opportunities to improve coverage and accuracy
 defining quality metrics and building the dashboards and checks that track them over time
 building and maintaining ground-truth datasets and labeling guidelines, and running labeling processes
 evaluating the output of llm and ml models: error analysis, comparing approaches, and turning findings into concrete improvements
 using llms and ai tools to speed up analysis, labeling and data review
 helping define and maintain taxonomies and classification rules together with product
 supporting client-related needs with our customer-facing teams, from in-depth analyses of specific market segments to investigating and fixing data gaps raised by clients
 validating new data sources before they are added to the product
 partnering with product and engineering to translate findings into requirements and priorities
Requirements: 
 this is the perfect job for someone who:
 holds a b.sc. in industrial engineering, statistics, economics, Computer Science or another quantitative field
 has 2+ years of experience as a data analyst, preferably in a tech company
 has strong sql skills
 uses Python for data analysis (pandas, notebooks) - must
 has a solid understanding of statistics and evaluation metrics: sampling, precision/recall, confidence levels
 has hands-on experience using llms for data work, such as prompting, structured outputs or reviewing model outputs
 has strong attention to detail and a structured approach to messy, ambiguous data 
 communicates clearly in english and can present findings to product, engineering and customer-facing teams
 has experience with labeling, taxonomies or data quality processes (advantage)
 has experience with e-commerce or product data (advantage)
 has experience with BI and visualization tools (advantage)
at the company, collaborating with our colleagues in-office creates a more connected, unified culture. our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.
This position is open to all candidates.

jobs.title: מהנדס.ת תהליכים - במחלקה לתשתיות למחקר כימי
jobs.description:
אחריות על תפעול, ניהול ותחזוקה של ציוד ומכשור מדעי מתקדם בתחומי המיקרו/ננו-פבריקציה, הליתוגרפיה והעיבוד הכימי.
 הפעלה ופיתוח תהליכים באמצעות מערכות ליתוגרפיה, מיקרו-פלואידיקה (Microfluidics), עיבוד כימי רטוב (Wet Chemical Processing) ומכשור מדעי מתקדם.
 פיתוח, התאמה ואופטימיזציה של תהליכים מורכבים בהתאם לצורכי המחקר, לרבות הגדרת פרמטרים ותנאי עבודה.
 מתן ייעוץ מדעי וטכנולוגי לקבוצות מחקר, הדרכה וליווי של סטודנטים וחוקרים בעבודה עם המכשור.
 ייזום והובלת פרויקטים מדעיים ותהליכי מחקר ופיתוח, תוך שיתוף פעולה עם קבוצות מחקר וצוותים רב-תחומיים במכון.

 תואר שני בהנדסה, הנדסת חומרים, כימיה, פיזיקה - חובה (תואר שלישי - יתרון משמעותי) 
 ניסיון מוכח בתחום המיקרו/ננו פבריקציה בסביבת חדרים נקיים
 ידע רחב והבנה מעמיקה בתהליכי ליטוגרפיה
 שליטה בשפות עברית ואנגלית ברמה גבוהה
 חשיבה אנליטית, יצירתיות ויכולת קבלת החלטות מבוססת נתונים
 יוזמה ויכולת הנעה והובלת פרויקטים מדעיים 
 יסודיות, סדר וארגון
 יכולת עבודה עצמאית, עבודה עם מערכות מחשוב, בקרה ומכניקה מורכבות

jobs.title: מהנדס /ת תהליכי ייצור ותמיכה טכנולוגית | תעשיית הפארמה (טכנולוג /ית ייצור)
jobs.location: נתניה, יקנעם, נוף הגליל, נשר, חיפה
jobs.description:
